findings.claim: WNA 燃料報告：新礦開發期由 8–15 年拉長到 10–20 年；現有礦產 2030 後十年約減半，需新礦與重啟；短期礦端供給足夠
findings.source: World Nuclear News: Investment decisions needed to avoid fuel cycle supply gaps
findings.excerpt: the time to develop new mines is actually getting longer, not shorter

findings.claim: 同來源：全球濃縮供給至少到 2030 年代初期仍超過需求（對濃縮廠商偏負面的供需說法，與 LEU 管理層『供需失衡擴大』說法並存）
findings.source: World Nuclear News: Investment decisions needed to avoid fuel cycle supply gaps
findings.excerpt: supply exceeds demand through to at least the early 2030s

findings.claim: WNA 2025 Nuclear Fuel Report：2030 年反應爐鈾需求較現在高約 28%，2040 年前年複合成長 5.3%（前版 4.1%）；2027–2028 無 WNA 官方數字
findings.source: Mining Weekly: Uranium demand set to surge 28% by 2030, WNA says
findings.excerpt: Global uranium demand is expected to soar as nuclear power cements its role in the clean energy transition

findings.claim: Centrus 2026 Q2 公告：LEU/HALEU 濃縮 backlog 達 30 億美元（24 億已 definitized），總 backlog 45 億美元延伸至 2040；CEO 稱濃縮供需失衡擴大、公告 LEU 價格續升；DOE 9 億美元 HALEU 獎助支持首批新產能約 2029 年上線（皆為公司自述）
findings.source: Centrus Energy 8-K Q2 2026 earnings release / MarketBeat Q2 call highlights

findings.claim: 部落格/行銷類來源多稱鈾缺口為結構性（2026 初級供給缺口約 3,100 萬磅 U3O8，需求 2.04 億磅 vs 礦產 1.73 億磅）；來源品質低，作者不明，數字未經一手核對
findings.source: Skillings: Uranium market outlook 2026 widening supply gap
findings.excerpt: Primary Reactor Demand 204 Million lbs U₃O₈; Primary Mine Production 173 Million lbs U₃O₈; Global Supply Deficit 31 Million lbs U₃O₈

note: Skillings as_of 為估計日；鈾礦端缺口與濃縮端供需分屬不同環節，來源間說法不一致。Centrus 數字皆管理層自述，未見獨立分析師佐證。
